Title: Public preview: Draft extension for Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)

Body.Content:
Start from source code and get a non-containerized application deployed to a Kubernetes cluster through Draft, the open-source project that streamlines Kubernetes development. Draft will be integrated with AKS through the Azure CLI, Azure Portal, and Visual Studio Code. Using Draft, you can generate a Dockerfile, Kubernetes manifests, Helm chart or Kustomize configurations, and automate CI/CD via GitHub Actions.

Learn more.
